sources.snippet: The adapter silently did nothing. Heretic loads Qwen3.8 as a vision+text model, so the adapter's keys are model.language_model.layers.*. The text-only class expects model.layers.*. PEFT prints a long "missing adapter keys" warning and runs the original model. → fix_adapter_keys.py. Slow "falling back to reference implementation" warnings.

sources.title: OpenIntelligenceNet/Qwen-3.8-27B-Heretic - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a 27 billion parameter causal language model developed by Qwen, built upon the Qwen3.5 architecture. This native vision-language model supports image and video understanding, excelling in coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. It features flexible thinking control and a 32,768 token context length, extensible up to 1,000,000 tokens with YaRN scaling.
